141:t_10:34.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「W-What...!? I was only trying to celebrate our reunion...」

141:t_10:35.en:
$$五飛$$
「I simply can't trust you... Don't come near me.」

141:t_10:37.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But I... I know. Whatever you say, you cannot reject me completely.」

141:t_10:39.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You intuitively distinguish justice from evil, $$五飛$$. I don't know what you sensed in me, but please remember just this...」

141:t_10:40.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That risking your life and throwing it away may look alike, but they are different things.」

141:t_10:42.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「During the $$時獄戦役$$, you should have learned that living itself is a battle.」

141:t_10:43.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Then please survive with $$ナタク$$, for the sake of the person dear to you who entrusted their hopes to you.」

141:t_10:45.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Information is a dimensional merchant's lifeline. But I will accept any reprimand for having overstepped my bounds.」

141:t_10:47.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Now that we've reached a $$ナタク$$-standing, let's put our all into today's... business, business!」

141:t_10:48.en:
$$五飛$$
「I knew you couldn't be trusted!」

142:t_000:0.en:
$$五飛$$
(...We withdrew in time. Now $$ロジャー$$ and the others will lead them to join $$ゼロ$$'s main force...)

142:t_000:1.en:
$$五飛$$
(...Leave the rest to me. I will stake my life on protecting your pride.)

142:t_000:2.en:
$$五飛$$
(The Miracle of $$厳島$$... I don't know how much I can accomplish alone, but I'll do all I can.)

142:t_000:3.en:
$$五飛$$
($$トレーズ$$... I have fought believing that living and continuing to fight is justice...)

142:t_000:4.en:
$$五飛$$
(But today, I stake everything. After all my doubts, mistakes and wandering, this is where I will die.)

142:t_000:5.en:
$$五飛$$
(With my life, I'll carry hope into tomorrow to build true peace in this world...!)

142:t_001:0.en:
$$五飛$$
「So they're the advance force... They're a little lacking as my final opponents...」

142:t_002:0.en:
$$五飛$$
「Let's do this, $$ナタク$$! I'll burn out my life right here!」

142:t_002:1.en:
???
「Don't try to look cool all by yourself.」

142:t_003:0.en:
$$五飛$$
「$$竜馬$$...! And $$ロジャー$$ and $$キリコ$$ too...!」

142:t_003:1.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「I've entrusted the troops' evacuation to $$ノーマン$$. You needn't worry.」

142:t_003:2.en:
$$キリコ$$
「We've completed our mission. From here on, we'll do as we please.」

142:t_003:3.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「A glorious death in battle may become a legend, but it leaves grief for those left behind.」

142:t_003:4.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Protecting this planet is all the reason we need to fight. I don't intend to avenge you.」

142:t_003:6.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「You are a very earnest man. I knew that somewhere inside, you were trying to atone for the previous war.」

142:t_003:7.en:
$$キリコ$$
「Don't cling to pointless pride. It's painful for us to watch.」

142:t_003:8.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Let's win a miracle comeback, not a suicide charge! With you, an $$異能生存体$$, a $$陰月$$ returnee and a smooth-talking world savior, we can do anything!」

142:t_003:9.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「I take issue with some of that wording, but that is the idea.」

142:t_003:10.en:
$$五飛$$
「...I'm sorry. I may have been about to take the wrong path again.」

142:t_003:12.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Let us forget debts between us. After all, from here on we live or die together.」

142:t_003:13.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Let's do it, Commander! I'm counting on you to fire us up with a rallying cry!」

142:t_003:14.en:
$$五飛$$
($$黎星刻$$... Just as you said, through battle I have gained the treasure of comrades...)

142:t_004:0.en:
$$五飛$$
「We'll bring about the Miracle of $$厳島$$ once more! But I won't allow a single one of you to die!」

142:t_004:1.en:
$$五飛$$
「Living is a battle! We will seize victory!」

142:t_005:1.en:
$$五飛$$
「They were only probing us. Their main force is waiting behind them.」

142:t_005:2.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Fine by me...! The real fight starts when they get here!」

142:t_005:4.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「I know...! The second wave is coming...!」

142:t_006:1.en:
$$竜馬$$
「The $$アストラギウス$$ bastards got hired by $$サイデリアル$$?!」

142:t_006:2.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Be careful! They aren't the only reinforcements!」

142:t_007:0.en:
$$五飛$$
「They're $$ネオ・ジオン$$ and Federation troops...!」

142:t_007:1.en:
$$竜馬$$
「This timing... It doesn't look like the $$ジオン$$ bastards are just following $$サイデリアル$$'s lead to take $$新日本$$.」

142:t_007:2.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「And the Federation troops are probably not here to intercept them.」

142:t_008:0.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「So $$ゼロ$$ and the others have arrived too.」

142:t_008:1.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「$$五飛$$...! What is going on here...?!」

142:t_008:3.en:
$$五飛$$
「$$ネオ・ジオン$$ and some of the Federation troops have sided with $$サイデリアル$$!」

142:t_008:4.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「That $$ヤクト・ドーガ$$...! It's $$ギュネイ$$!」

142:t_008:6.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「$$ギュネイ$$! Has $$ネオ・ジオン$$ surrendered to the Empire?!」

142:t_008:9.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「All units, begin your attack. Our mission is to take this base.」

142:t_008:10.en:
$$五飛$$
「How pathetic... You cast aside your pride to survive.」

142:t_008:11.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Captain $$オットー$$, give the order to intercept them!」

142:t_008:13.en:
$$オットー$$
「All units, begin your attack! If they attack us, it doesn't matter whether they're $$ジオン$$ or Federation troops! Don't let them through!」

142:t_008:14.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「$$サイデリアル$$... The $$地球連邦$$... Is this that man's vision for $$ジオン$$'s future...?」

142:t_008:15.en:
$$五飛$$
「$$竜馬$$, $$ロジャー$$, $$キリコ$$! Regroup!」

142:t_009:0.en:
$$デュオ$$
「Looks like $$五飛$$ was doing a proper job of commanding.」

142:t_009:1.en:
$$トロワ$$
「He was the only one who could have filled that role.」

142:t_009:2.en:
$$カトル$$
「Yes. He now understands the true meaning of fighting.」

142:t_009:3.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Let's go, to protect the Miracle of $$厳島$$ too.」

142:t_009:4.en:
$$五飛$$
「Those of you who surrendered to the Empire! Know that you have no future after casting aside your pride!」

142:t_010:0.en:
$$レイアム$$
「I've confirmed that all enemies have been destroyed.」

142:t_010:1.en:
$$オットー$$
「But I can't celebrate this victory without reservation...」

142:t_010:2.en:
$$レイアム$$
「Yes... We didn't just confirm our fears that $$ネオ・ジオン$$ and $$サイデリアル$$ were colluding...」
